title: Japanese Woman Takes 'Safe' Mumbai Aqua Line, Compares It To Train In Her Country. But Desis Say 'Zuban Kesari Gang...' | Viral News - News18
text: Mumbai now has its first fully underground metro corridor! The newly completed Metro-3, also called the Aqua Line, stretches from Aarey in the north to Cuffe Parade in the south. The final section was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on October 8. The new metro line is already creating waves online, and now a Japanese expat has shared her first ride experience. Her video capturing the journey has caught widespread attention for its detailed observations. ‘Felt Like I Was Back In Japan’ The expat begins her video inviting viewers along, saying, “Come take the new Mumbai Metro Line with me for the first time." She explains that while she initially planned to drive home, Google Maps suggested a one-and-a-half-hour journey by car. “So, I thought, why not try the new metro instead? And see what was up," she adds. During the ride, she noticed that the line passes through key spots like Bandra, BKC and even the airport. “Honestly, I kid you not, I felt like I was back in Japan – clean, safe and perfectly on time," she says. She was impressed by the spacious, spotless stations and the availability of a women-only section. Her experience as a regular public transport user made the convenience stand out even more. ‘Mumbai, You’re On The Right Track’ The journey also gave her a chance to meet new people. She recalls, “I met Vijay-san – turns out we were both heading to Andheri. We ended up chatting for almost an hour, which made the ride even better." After reaching Andheri, she changed lines with a short five-minute walk to reach home. She notes, “Still reached faster than I would’ve reached by car. Honestly, a girlie who’s taken public transport most of her life – it felt really good." She concludes the video by emphasising the importance of public transport in city life: “I always say a city with good public transport and walkable streets is doing something right. So, Mumbai – you’re definitely on the right track…let’s just speed it up a bit. But first Mumbai metro experience? Great success." The video was shared on X (formerly Twitter) with the caption, “A Japanese expat living in Mumbai tries the newly built aqua line of Mumbai Metro, and she finds it the most reliable mode of transportation." Watch The Clip Here What Viewers Are Saying The video received massive attention online with more than two lakh views so far. In the comments section, social media users shared their varied reactions. A user commented, “I think reliable public transit is absolutely game-changing for any traveller, especially in a bustling place like Mumbai. When you aren’t stressed about getting from point A to point B, you can truly focus on soaking up the local culture and enjoying those unexpected moments." Another said, “Good to see such development." Someone shared their own experience, writing, “True. I also travelled today from the airport to Kalbadevi. Best experience." “If it’s only just opened, it is too early to decide whether it is reliable or not. Looks nice, though. Let’s revisit in a few months," a person noted. Meanwhile, a comment read, “Zuban kesari gang ready." About The Aqua Line The Aqua Line, built at a cost of Rs 37,270 crore, runs entirely underground and features 27 stations. Construction began in 2017 under the Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (MMRCL) and, at its peak, involved over 15,000 workers. The new line connects key business hubs such as Fort, Churchgate, BKC, and Nariman Point, while also providing direct access to both domestic and international airport terminals.
